blocks.text: Anne Curtis was not quite ready to show off her singing skills in front of her longtime idol, South Korean actor Gong Yoo, as she playfully turned down the audience’s request for a song during his Manila fan meeting. Curtis served as the host of Gong Yoo’s “2026 Asia Fanmeeting Tour: The Long Take” at the Big Dome in Quezon City on Saturday, Nov. 21, where she and the Korean actor shared several lighthearted moments with the audience.
